JsonMatch.description:
Values of a JSON document: a JSONPath (RFC 9535), and optionally a regular expression their text must
match.

text.description: a regular expression a matched string value must match (search)
text.title: Text

JsonMatch.title: JsonMatch

Rule.description: One convention: what it matches, the decision about it, and why.

decision.description: a decision's name (linecaster.markup.decisions.DECISIONS, or a package's)
decision.title: Decision

by.description: who made what the decision records: the source's people (they marked it) or a rule (the conventions infer it)
by.title: By

before.description: placed before this rule (where order matters)
before.title: Before

after.description: placed after this rule (where order matters)
after.title: After

Rule.title: Rule

TextMatch.description:
Spans of a plain text: a regular expression (Python's ``re``, multiline); a group named ``text``, where the
pattern has one, is the span the decision is about, else the whole match.

pattern.description: a regular expression, searched with re.MULTILINE
pattern.title: Pattern

TextMatch.title: TextMatch

TreeMatch.description:
Elements of an HTML or XML tree: a CSS selector, and optionally conditions on their text, inline style and
ancestors. Every condition given must hold.

css.description: a CSS selector (Selectors Level 3, as cssselect reads it)
css.title: Css

text.description: a regular expression the element's text must match (search)
text.title: Text

style.description: a regular expression the element's style attribute must match
style.title: Style

inside.description: a CSS selector one of the element's ancestors must match
inside.title: Inside

not_inside.description: a CSS selector none of the element's ancestors may match
not_inside.title: Not Inside

TreeMatch.title: TreeMatch

description:
A conventions entry (``linecaster.conventions``; catalog entries carry no edition: the linecaster release
versions them).

format.description: the format whose importer applies the entry: html, xml, json, text, ...
format.title: Format

source.description: what the entry was written against: the source, its software and versions, the dump or export
source.title: Source

disable.description: a parent's rule id -> why it does not apply
disable.title: Disable

transcription.description: the normalizations the source's transcription already embodies (catalog normalization ids: long-s when it writes ſ as s, divided-words when it joins a word divided within a page, ...); importers copy them into Source.normalized and scoring checks a lane against them. A child's list replaces its parent's; none given: the parent's
transcription.title: Transcription
